externalEvidence: Iskin (6th ed. 2022), § II.H; Finkbeiner v. Lutz, 44 Ohio App.2d 223, 337 N.E.2d 655 (1st Dist. 1975)

rule_audit.summary: Repeated acceptance of late rent may alter the operative due date until the landlord gives advance notice ending the course of conduct.

rule_audit.name: Public housing termination notice and grievance prerequisite
rule_audit.label: Public housing termination notice and grievance prerequisite (24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57)
rule_audit.summary: A PHA termination notice must meet program-specific content and timing requirements, and when a grievance hearing is available the tenancy cannot terminate before the request period and any timely requested grievance are complete.
rule_audit.source: 24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57; Cuyahoga Metro. Hous. Auth. v. Younger, 93 Ohio App.3d 819 (8th Dist. 1994); Iskin (6th ed. 2022), § III.F
rule_audit.excerpt: MHA served Harrison a termination notice effective April 11, 2023, citing lease violation for unauthorized guests. Harrison timely requested a grievance hearing on February 22, 2023. Argument Under 24 C.F.R. § 966.4(l)(3), a PHA-operated public housing tenancy can be terminated only in accordance with § 966.4(l). rule_audit.name: Security deposits
rule_audit.label: Security deposits (R.C. 5321.16)
rule_audit.summary: On termination, a landlord must itemize and return a security deposit within the statutory period, and a landlord who wrongfully withholds may owe damages and attorney fees. A tenant claiming it has to establish the deposit, the forwarding address, the failure, and the amount claimed.
